<!--
Thank you for helping keep VetClaw accurate. Clinical accuracy is our
highest priority. Please complete every REQUIRED field below so a reviewer
can verify and fix the issue quickly.

NOT FOR EMERGENCIES: If an animal is sick or may have been poisoned, contact
a veterinarian or a poison control center now (ASPCA 888-426-4435 /
Pet Poison Helpline 855-764-7661). Do not wait on a GitHub issue.
-->

## Affected skill (REQUIRED)

<!-- Path to the SKILL.md file, e.g. skills/safety/toxicology-calculator/SKILL.md -->
Skill path:

Section / heading within the skill (if known):

## Species (REQUIRED)

<!-- The species (and breed, if relevant) the claim applies to. Corrections are
often species-specific, so this is essential. -->


## The claim as currently written (REQUIRED)

<!-- Quote the exact text, value, dose, or range as it appears in the skill today.
Copy it verbatim so we can locate and confirm it. -->


## The correct value / claim (REQUIRED)

<!-- What it should say instead. Include units, route, frequency, and species
where applicable. -->


## Citable veterinary reference (REQUIRED)

<!-- At least one citable source supporting the correction: a textbook (with
edition and page/chapter), a published clinical guideline or consensus statement,
a formulary (e.g. Plumb's) entry, or a primary-source journal article (with DOI
or PMID if available). Corrections without a verifiable reference cannot be merged. -->


## Submitter qualifications (optional)

<!-- Optional but helpful for triage: veterinary degree, board certification,
specialty, or relevant expertise. Leave blank if you prefer. -->


## Additional context (optional)

<!-- Anything else that helps us evaluate the correction. -->
